test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

I did not get __many sleep__ last night as my sister was running a high fever.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Much sleep**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence uses "not many sleep", which is incorrect grammar. The correct phrase is "**not much sleep**".
 
• "Much sleep" means a large amount of sleep, which is the opposite of what the speaker got.
 
• The sentence indicates that the speaker's sister was sick, so it is reasonable to assume that the speaker was worried or taking care of their sister, which could explain why they did not get much sleep.

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Some sleep**", would be a better choice of words than the original sentence, but it still doesn't accurately convey the idea that the speaker got very little sleep.
 
• "**None sleep**", is grammatically incorrect and doesn't make sense.
 
• "**Most sleep**", is the opposite of what the speaker experienced and therefore doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
